props.code:
var clip := Animation.new()
	var active_on := STARTUP                      # frame 1
	var recovery_on := STARTUP + ACTIVE           # frame 2
	var end_on := STARTUP + ACTIVE + RECOVERY     # frame 5
	clip.length = end_on / FPS
	clip.step = 1.0 / FPS
	clip.loop_mode = Animation.LOOP_NONE
	# A key's transition shapes the segment after it: 1.0 linear, 0.5 ease-out.
	var p := clip.add_track(Animation.TYPE_VALUE)
	clip.track_set_path(p, POS_PATH)
	clip.value_track_set_update_mode(p, Animation.UPDATE_CONTINUOUS)
	clip.track_insert_key(p, 0.0, REST_POS, 1.0)
	clip.track_insert_key(p, active_on / FPS, DOWN_POS, 0.5)
	clip.track_insert_key(p, end_on / FPS, REST_POS, 1.0)

beats.role_note: Code beat: scripts/tank.gd lines 88-101 (Suspension above hull/turret; both AnimationPlayers on the physics clock), verbatim; the brief's authority table in notes.
beats.narration_text: One authority per animated node, from the brief's table. Dust frame: only MotionAnim. Suspension: only FireAnim. Hull and turret position: only tank dot g d, every tick. That's why Suspension sits above them. And both players run on the physics clock.

beats.role_note: Recorded headless results at 4f88f1b: readback 49, anim_states 34, edges 27, pins 11.
beats.narration_text: The read-backs. Clip read back: forty nine checks. States: thirty four, at thirty, sixty and one forty four. The new edge test: every boundary, with a hit, a death and a second fire, a tick before, on and after: twenty seven, at all three. Pins: eleven. Only one, two and four moved, two ticks, as predicted.

props.title: What the Read-backs Proved
props.status: HEADLESS · the student's recorded logs at 4f88f1b · nothing drawn

beats.role_note: Mutations from logs/a7-mutations.txt, each in a git worktree; the C1 blind spot; headless limit.
beats.narration_text: Mutations, each in a worktree. Frame renamed frames, loop flipped, a key on cell four: all caught. An empty cache reimport passed, as expected: a baked rig has no importer. Continuous track, shell on frame two: caught. The blind spot: C1 checks only the size of the gap, so a flipped sign passed. And headless can't show whether motion reads.

props.title: Mutations and the Blind Spot
props.status: logs/a7-mutations.txt · each mutation in its own git worktree, control passes first · HEADLESS

beats.role_note: Strip readings: v1 squash (Claude vs the student), dust strips v1-v3, TUNING.md revisions 1 and 2.
beats.narration_text: Reading the strips. Claude measured the squash at about five percent: slight. The student looked carefully, judged it clearly visible, and kept it. For dust, the student saw v2 faintly; Claude found no dust pixels. V3 moved it thirty four pixels back, and it shows, in all eight facings.

props.title: Reading the Strips
props.status: FIXTURE STRIPS (student's captures): shoot_strip_v1, dust_strip_v1–v3 · TUNING.md revisions 1, 2

beats.role_note: Verdict: agent mistakes caught, uncertainty, next step, contributions, sheet source, revision.
beats.narration_text: The verdict, at revision four f eight eight f one b. The student caught two failing tests the agent never ran, an unrequested script, a dust guess hidden under the hull, and a parse check that never loads the preview. Uncertain: at thirty f p s, second presses land on even ticks only; and with reload forced to zero, a shot on P plus ten doesn't replay the clip, which play can't reach. Next: replay shoot on every new shot.

show.event: who did what, sheet source, revision

artifactLines: Caught: the agent said test_hit_flash and test_cover_hit_burst_state would survive and didn't run them; both failed. Fixed: fired with the shell, aim on the press tick, the frozen enemy runs.
Also: an unrequested logs/_run_all.sh (deleted) · DUST_BEHIND 14 hid the dust · check_tools_parse never loads the preview.
Uncertain: at 30 fps a 2nd press lands on even ticks only (P+9, P+11 missed) · reload 0: a shot on P+10 doesn't replay shoot (unreachable: reload 48 > clip 10 ticks).
Next step: make shoot replay from its start whenever a new shot starts.

The student: design, every test, capture and human check · Claude Code: CLAUDE.md, pins, nodes, wiring, preview · Claude chat: sheet generator, bake tool, read-back, mutation and fix scripts, brief wording.
Sheet: made by code (tools/make_dust_sheet.gd), the student's own work, no third-party art.
